hotspots.rationale: Bounded 2026-10-06 managed-profile, schema-40 and live-control slices; independently reviewed architectural scope. Selection context is injected explicitly into the existing single-connection facade and task-notice domain; state_sessions owns generation policy, admission owns atomic input/job/notice transactions, and preacceptance_binding owns early-notice provenance checks. The nullable snapshots do not move SQLite ownership or introduce configuration loading. A separate facade for only context forwarding would duplicate the transaction boundary. codex_permission_refusals owns atomic input-refusal policy and SQL; ProviderJobsStateFacade owns passive album lookup. The narrow live-control addition forwards an explicit existing-state timeout; state_connection owns opening and code-based contention classification. COMMIT remains inside this facade's protected transaction boundary so a failed commit rolls back before reuse. Stacked closeout includes the three-line read-only retained-session forwarding method; SessionsStateFacade retains session query/policy ownership, with no new transaction, lifecycle or authority. No provider invocation or monitor policy belongs here. Bounded Claude model/effort continuity adds only a trusted runtime keyword to the existing forwarding method; SessionsStateFacade retains the settings transaction, identity policy and snapshot checks. ExecutionJournal remains sole native root-provenance owner. Extracting this seven-line forwarding change would duplicate the facade without reducing responsibility.
